"""Analiza una pagina y propone ajustes de conversion."""
import re
from collections import Counter

from .pipeline import PT_TO_MM, convert

PAPER_SIZES = {  # mm (lado corto, lado largo)
    "A4": (210, 297), "A3": (297, 420), "A2": (420, 594), "A1": (594, 841), "A0": (841, 1189),
    "Carta": (216, 279), "Oficio": (216, 356), "Tabloide": (279, 432),
    "ARCH D": (610, 914), "ARCH E": (914, 1219),
}

SCALE_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![\d.,])1\s*[:/]\s*(\d{1,5})(?![\d.,])")
SCALE_KW = re.compile(r"\b(esc(ala)?|scale|maßstab)\b", re.I)


def paper_name(w_pt, h_pt):
    a, b = sorted((w_pt * PT_TO_MM, h_pt * PT_TO_MM))
    for name, (s, l) in PAPER_SIZES.items():
        if abs(a - s) < 6 and abs(b - l) < 6:
            return name
    return "%.0f x %.0f mm" % (b, a)


def detect_scale(texts):
    votes = Counter()
    for t in texts:
        s = t["text"]
        for m in SCALE_RE.finditer(s):
            n = int(m.group(1))
            if n < 1 or n > 20000:
                continue
            w = 3 if SCALE_KW.search(s) else 1
            votes[n] += w
    if not votes:
        return None, []
    ranked = [n for n, _ in votes.most_common()]
    return ranked[0], ranked


def analyze(pd, progress=None):
    prog = progress or (lambda f, m=None: None)
    prog(0.0, "Analizando el plano")
    page_area = pd.width * pd.height
    n_seg = sum(len(sp["segs"]) for p in pd.paths for sp in p["subpaths"])
    n_curves = sum(1 for p in pd.paths for sp in p["subpaths"] for s in sp["segs"] if s[0] == "C")
    n_fill = sum(1 for p in pd.paths if p["kind"] in ("fill", "both"))
    n_white = sum(1 for p in pd.paths if p["fill"] is not None and min(p["fill"]) >= 250)
    n_dash = sum(1 for p in pd.paths if p["dashes"])
    tiny = sum(1 for p in pd.paths for sp in p["subpaths"] for s in sp["segs"]
               if s[0] == "L" and ((s[1][0] - s[2][0]) ** 2 + (s[1][1] - s[2][1]) ** 2) < 1.5 ** 2)
    img_area = sum(max(0, (x1 - x0)) * max(0, (y1 - y0)) for x0, y0, x1, y1 in pd.images)
    layers_used = sorted({p["layer"] for p in pd.paths if p["layer"]})

    recs = []
    sug = {}

    def rec(level, title, detail, apply=None, rid=None):
        recs.append({"id": rid or title, "level": level, "title": title, "detail": detail,
                     "apply": apply or {}})
        if apply:
            sug.update(apply)

    # --- escaneado ---
    if img_area > 0.5 * page_area and n_seg < 300:
        rec("error", "El PDF parece escaneado (imagen)",
            "La pagina es practicamente una imagen y casi no tiene vectores. No se puede obtener un CAD "
            "fiel: haria falta vectorizar la imagen. Se exportara solo lo vectorial que exista.",
            rid="raster")
    elif pd.images:
        rec("info", "Contiene %d imagen(es)" % len(pd.images),
            "Las imagenes (logos, fotos, rellenos raster) no se convierten a vectores.", rid="images")

    # --- escala ---
    scale, ranked = detect_scale(pd.texts)
    if scale:
        alt = ", ".join("1:%d" % n for n in ranked[1:4])
        rec("ok", "Escala detectada 1:%d" % scale,
            "Se encontro en los textos del plano." + (" Otras escalas presentes: %s (si hay varios "
            "dibujos a distinta escala, calibra con una cota conocida)." % alt if alt else "") +
            " Verificala con la herramienta Calibrar midiendo una cota.",
            {"scale_mode": "ratio", "scale_ratio": scale}, rid="scale")
    else:
        rec("warn", "No se encontro la escala",
            "No hay textos tipo 'ESC 1:50'. Usa Calibrar: marca dos puntos de una cota conocida y "
            "escribe su medida real. Mientras tanto se exporta a escala 1:1 (mm de papel).",
            rid="scale")

    # --- capas ---
    if layers_used:
        rec("ok", "El PDF trae %d capas" % len(layers_used),
            "Se conservaran los nombres de capa originales (%s%s)." %
            (", ".join(layers_used[:6]), "..." if len(layers_used) > 6 else ""),
            {"layer_mode": "ocg"}, rid="layers")
    else:
        cols = Counter(p["color"] or p["fill"] for p in pd.paths)
        rec("info", "Sin capas en el PDF: se crearan por color",
            "El PDF no tiene capas (OCG). Se agrupara por color (%d colores distintos), que suele "
            "corresponder a los plumines/capas del CAD original." % len(cols),
            {"layer_mode": "color"}, rid="layers")

    # --- hatches (prueba con valores por defecto) ---
    trial = convert(pd, {"fills": False, "texts": False, "hatch_snap": False},
                    progress=lambda f, m=None: prog(0.05 + 0.9 * f, m))
    hs = trial["hatches"]
    if hs:
        n_abs = sum(h["n_lines"] for h in hs)
        n_susp = sum(1 for h in hs if h.get("suspect"))
        sps = sorted(f["spacing"] * PT_TO_MM for h in hs for f in h["families"])
        detail = ("Se pueden reconstruir %d hatches a partir de %d lineas sueltas. Espaciados en papel "
                  "entre %.2f y %.2f mm." % (len(hs), n_abs, sps[0], sps[-1]))
        apply = {"detect_hatches": True, "hatch_snap": True}
        if sps[-1] > 10:
            apply["hatch_max_spacing_mm"] = round(min(40, sps[-1] * 1.3), 1)
        rec("ok", "Hatches explotados detectados", detail, apply, rid="hatches")
        if n_susp:
            rec("warn", "%d hatch(es) dudosos" % n_susp,
                "Lineas paralelas de igual longitud o muy separadas (escaleras, persianas, "
                "celosias...). Aparecen marcados en naranja: revisalos y rechaza los que no sean hatch.",
                rid="suspect")
    else:
        rec("info", "No se detectaron hatches de lineas",
            "Si sabes que hay hatches, prueba a subir 'Espaciado maximo' o bajar 'Lineas minimas'.",
            rid="hatches")

    # --- rellenos ---
    if n_fill:
        apply = {"fills": True, "merge_fills": True}
        if n_fill > 20:
            rec("ok", "%d rellenos solidos fragmentados" % n_fill,
                "Se fusionaran los trozos adyacentes del mismo color en un solo HATCH SOLID.",
                apply, rid="fills")
        else:
            rec("info", "%d rellenos solidos" % n_fill, "Se convertiran a HATCH SOLID.", apply, rid="fills")
    if n_white:
        rec("info", "%d rellenos blancos (mascaras)" % n_white,
            "Suelen ser wipeouts/fondos que tapan geometria; se recomienda omitirlos.",
            {"skip_white_fills": True}, rid="white")

    # --- curvas ---
    if n_curves:
        rec("ok", "%d curvas Bezier" % n_curves,
            "Se convertiran a arcos y circulos reales cuando coincidan (lo normal en planos CAD); "
            "el resto queda como SPLINE.", {"curves_to_arcs": True}, rid="curves")

    if n_dash:
        rec("ok", "%d trazos discontinuos" % n_dash,
            "Se crearan tipos de linea equivalentes en lugar de explotar los guiones.",
            {"linetypes": True}, rid="dashes")

    if pd.clips:
        rec("info", "%d trazados de recorte" % len(pd.clips),
            "Hay geometria recortada (tipico de Revit/patrones). Se aplicara el recorte para no "
            "exportar lineas que sobresalen.", {"clip_paths": True}, rid="clips")

    if not pd.texts and tiny > 500:
        rec("warn", "Textos vectorizados",
            "No hay texto real y si muchos trazos diminutos (%d): probablemente los textos son fuentes "
            "SHX convertidas a lineas. Se exportaran como geometria." % tiny, rid="shx")
    elif pd.texts:
        rec("ok", "%d textos editables" % len(pd.texts),
            "Se exportaran como TEXT conservando posicion, rotacion y altura.", {"texts": True},
            rid="texts")

    rec("info", "Merge de lineas colineales",
        "Los PDF suelen partir lineas largas en tramos; se unen los tramos colineales y se eliminan "
        "duplicados.", {"merge_collinear": True, "join_polylines": True}, rid="collinear")

    return {
        "paper": paper_name(pd.width, pd.height),
        "metrics": {
            "trazados": pd.n_raw_paths, "segmentos": n_seg, "curvas": n_curves, "rellenos": n_fill,
            "textos": len(pd.texts), "imagenes": len(pd.images), "capas": len(layers_used),
            "recortes": len(pd.clips),
        },
        "recommendations": recs,
        "suggested": sug,
    }

"""Escritura del resultado a DXF."""
import math
import ezdxf
from ezdxf import colors as ezcolors
from ezdxf import const, units

from . import geom

PT_TO_MM = 25.4 / 72
LINEWEIGHTS = [0, 5, 9, 13, 15, 18, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50, 53, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100,
               106, 120, 140, 158, 200, 211]


def _lineweight(width_pt):
    mm100 = width_pt * PT_TO_MM * 100
    if mm100 <= 0:
        return 0
    return min(LINEWEIGHTS, key=lambda v: abs(v - mm100))


class DxfWriter:
    def __init__(self, res):
        self.res = res
        self.o = res["opts"]
        self.k = res["k"]
        self.doc = ezdxf.new("R2018", setup=True)
        u = self.o.get("units", "mm")
        self.doc.units = {"mm": units.MM, "cm": units.CM, "m": units.M}.get(u, units.MM)
        self.doc.header["$INSUNITS"] = self.doc.units
        self.doc.header["$LTSCALE"] = 1.0
        self.doc.header["$PSLTSCALE"] = 0
        self.doc.header["$LWDISPLAY"] = 1
        self.msp = self.doc.modelspace()
        self.layers = {}
        self.ltypes = {}
        if "PDF" not in self.doc.styles:
            self.doc.styles.add("PDF", font="arial.ttf")

    # ---------------- helpers ----------------
    def X(self, p):
        return (p[0] * self.k, p[1] * self.k)

    def ensure_layer(self, name, color):
        if name in self.layers:
            return
        lay = self.doc.layers.add(name) if name not in self.doc.layers else self.doc.layers.get(name)
        if self.o.get("layer_mode") in ("color", "color_width") and color:
            if tuple(color) == (0, 0, 0):
                lay.color = 7
            else:
                lay.rgb = tuple(color)
        self.layers[name] = color

    def attribs(self, ent):
        layer = ent["layer"]
        color = ent.get("color")
        self.ensure_layer(layer, color)
        a = {"layer": layer}
        if self.o.get("layer_mode") not in ("color", "color_width") and color is not None:
            if tuple(color) == (0, 0, 0):
                a["color"] = 7
            else:
                a["true_color"] = ezcolors.rgb2int(tuple(color))
        if self.o.get("lineweights") and ent.get("width") is not None:
            a["lineweight"] = _lineweight(ent["width"])
        d = ent.get("dashes")
        if d:
            a["linetype"] = self.ensure_ltype(d)
        return a

    def ensure_ltype(self, dashes):
        key = tuple(round(v, 3) for v in dashes)
        if key in self.ltypes:
            return self.ltypes[key]
        name = "PDF_DASH_%d" % (len(self.ltypes) + 1)
        pat = []
        for i, v in enumerate(dashes):
            L = v * self.k
            pat.append(L if i % 2 == 0 else -L)
        total = sum(abs(v) for v in pat)
        self.doc.linetypes.add(name, pattern=[total] + pat,
                               description="PDF " + " ".join("%.2f" % v for v in dashes))
        self.ltypes[key] = name
        return name

    # ---------------- escritura ----------------
    def write(self, progress=None):
        prog = progress or (lambda f, m=None: None)
        r = self.res
        prog(0.0, "Escribiendo hatches y rellenos")
        for f in r["fills"]:
            self._fill(f)
        for h in r["hatches"]:
            if not h.get("rejected"):
                self._hatch(h)
        prog(0.35, "Escribiendo lineas y polilineas")
        for ln in r["lines"]:
            self.msp.add_line(self.X(ln["p1"]), self.X(ln["p2"]), dxfattribs=self.attribs(ln))
        for p in r["polys"]:
            self._poly(p)
        for c in r["circles"]:
            self.msp.add_circle(self.X(c["c"]), c["r"] * self.k, dxfattribs=self.attribs(c))
        for a in r["arcs"]:
            self._arc(a)
        for s in r["splines"]:
            pts = [self.X(p) for p in s["ctrl"]]
            self.msp.add_open_spline(pts, degree=3, knots=[0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1],
                                     dxfattribs=self.attribs(s))
        prog(0.8, "Escribiendo textos")
        hf = float(self.o.get("text_height_factor", 0.72))
        for t in r["texts"]:
            a = {"layer": t["layer"], "style": "PDF", "rotation": t["angle"],
                 "height": max(1e-4, t["size"] * hf * self.k), "insert": self.X((t["x"], t["y"]))}
            self.ensure_layer(t["layer"], t.get("color"))
            col = t.get("color")
            if self.o.get("layer_mode") not in ("color",) and col is not None:
                if tuple(col) == (0, 0, 0):
                    a["color"] = 7
                else:
                    a["true_color"] = ezcolors.rgb2int(tuple(col))
            self.msp.add_text(t["text"], dxfattribs=a)
        return self.doc

    def _boundary(self, hatch, polygon, layer=None, color=None):
        """Contornos del hatch. Con 'hatch_boundary' cada anillo se crea tambien como
        LWPOLYLINE cerrada y el hatch queda ASOCIATIVO a ella (al editar la polilinea
        en CAD el hatch se actualiza). Las polilineas van a una capa _CONTORNO que no se
        imprime, para no duplicar los muros en el ploteo."""
        from .cleanup import clean_polygon
        polygon = clean_polygon(polygon) or polygon
        polys = [p for p in getattr(polygon, "geoms", [polygon]) if p.geom_type == "Polygon" and not p.is_empty]
        assoc = bool(self.o.get("hatch_boundary")) and layer is not None
        blayer = None
        if assoc:
            blayer = layer + "_CONTORNO"
            if blayer not in self.layers:
                self.ensure_layer(blayer, color)
                self.doc.layers.get(blayer).dxf.plot = 0
            hatch.dxf.associative = 1
        for p in polys:
            rings = [(p.exterior, const.BOUNDARY_PATH_EXTERNAL)] + [(r, const.BOUNDARY_PATH_DEFAULT) for r in p.interiors]
            for ring, flags in rings:
                pts = [self.X(c) for c in list(ring.coords)[:-1]]
                if len(pts) < 3:
                    continue
                path = hatch.paths.add_polyline_path(pts, is_closed=True, flags=flags)
                if assoc:
                    pl = self.msp.add_lwpolyline(pts, close=True, dxfattribs={"layer": blayer})
                    path.source_boundary_objects = [pl.dxf.handle]
                    pl.append_reactor_handle(hatch.dxf.handle)
        return polys

    def _fill(self, f):
        a = self.attribs({"layer": f["layer"], "color": f["color"]})
        h = self.msp.add_hatch(dxfattribs=a)
        col = f["color"]
        if tuple(col) == (0, 0, 0):
            h.set_solid_fill(color=7, style=0)
        else:
            h.set_solid_fill(color=7, style=0, rgb=tuple(col))
        self._boundary(h, f["polygon"], f["layer"], f["color"])

    def _hatch(self, hd):
        a = self.attribs({"layer": hd["layer"], "color": hd["color"]})
        h = self.msp.add_hatch(dxfattribs=a)
        k = self.k
        fams = hd["families"]
        lines = []
        for f in fams:
            th = math.radians(f["angle"])
            s = f["spacing"] * k
            off = (-math.sin(th) * s, math.cos(th) * s)
            dashes = [v * k for v in f["dashes"]] if f["dashes"] else []
            lines.append([f["angle"], self.X(f["base"]), off, dashes])
        pat = hd["pat"]
        name, ptype = pat["name"], pat["ptype"]
        col = a.get("color", 7)
        dummy = [[0, (0, 0), (0, 1), []]]
        if ptype == "predefined":
            h.set_pattern_fill(name, color=col, angle=pat["angle"], scale=pat["scale"] * k, style=0,
                               pattern_type=const.HATCH_TYPE_PREDEFINED, definition=dummy)
        elif ptype == "user":
            h.set_pattern_fill("_USER", color=col, angle=pat["angle"], scale=pat["scale"] * k,
                               double=1 if len(fams) == 2 else 0, style=0,
                               pattern_type=const.HATCH_TYPE_USER_DEFINED, definition=dummy)
        else:
            h.set_pattern_fill(name, color=col, angle=0, scale=1.0, style=0,
                               pattern_type=const.HATCH_TYPE_CUSTOM, definition=dummy)
        h.set_pattern_definition(lines)
        if "true_color" in a:
            h.dxf.true_color = a["true_color"]
        self._boundary(h, hd["polygon"], hd["layer"], hd["color"])

    def _poly(self, p):
        pts = []
        for s in p["segs"]:
            b = geom.bulge(s) if s[0] == "A" else 0.0
            x, y = self.X(s[1])
            pts.append((x, y, 0, 0, b))
        if not p["closed"]:
            x, y = self.X(geom.seg_end(p["segs"][-1]))
            pts.append((x, y, 0, 0, 0))
        self.msp.add_lwpolyline(pts, format="xyseb", close=p["closed"], dxfattribs=self.attribs(p))

    def _arc(self, a):
        c = self.X(a["c"])
        p1, p2 = self.X(a["p1"]), self.X(a["p2"])
        a1 = math.degrees(math.atan2(p1[1] - c[1], p1[0] - c[0]))
        a2 = math.degrees(math.atan2(p2[1] - c[1], p2[0] - c[0]))
        if not a["ccw"]:
            a1, a2 = a2, a1
        self.msp.add_arc(c, a["r"] * self.k, a1, a2, dxfattribs=self.attribs(a))


def export(res, out_path, fmt="dxf", progress=None):
    """Escribe el DXF (R2018). fmt se mantiene por compatibilidad: solo 'dxf'."""
    prog = progress or (lambda f, m=None: None)
    doc = DxfWriter(res).write(lambda f, m=None: prog(0.8 * f, m))
    prog(0.85, "Guardando archivo DXF")
    doc.saveas(out_path)
    prog(1.0, "Archivo listo")
    return out_path

"""Orquesta la conversion: extraccion -> hatches -> rellenos -> lineas -> modelo."""
import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict

from . import geom
from .fills import build_fills
from .cleanup import resolve_fill_overlaps, resolve_hatch_overlaps
from .hatch import classify_pattern, detect_hatches

PT_TO_MM = 25.4 / 72

DEFAULTS = {
    # escala
    "scale_mode": "ratio",       # 'ratio' (1:N) | 'factor' (calibrado)
    "scale_ratio": 1.0,          # N de 1:N
    "units": "mm",               # unidades del dibujo: mm | cm | m
    "scale_factor": None,        # unidades de dibujo por punto PDF (modo 'factor')
    # capas
    "layer_mode": "ocg",         # ocg | color | color_width | single
    "hatch_layer": "same",       # same | suffix | single
    # hatches
    "detect_hatches": True,
    "hatch_style": "ansi",       # ansi | user
    "hatch_min_lines": 6,
    "hatch_max_spacing_mm": 12,
    "hatch_angle_tol": 0.5,
    "hatch_spacing_tol": 0.15,
    "hatch_gap_factor": 0.5,
    "hatch_dashes": True,
    "hatch_isolated_only": True, # solo tramos sueltos (no polilineas) pueden ser hatch
    "hatch_boundary": True,      # contorno como polilinea cerrada asociada al hatch
    "fix_overlaps": True,        # sin solapes entre hatches / entre rellenos
    "hatch_snap": True,          # ajustar el contorno a las lineas existentes (muros)
    "rejected_hatches": [],
    # rellenos
    "fills": True,
    "merge_fills": True,
    "skip_white_fills": True,
    # lineas
    "clip_paths": True,
    "curves_to_arcs": True,
    "join_polylines": True,
    "merge_collinear": True,
    "lineweights": True,
    "linetypes": True,
    # texto
    "texts": True,
    "text_height_factor": 0.72,
    # depuracion de capas
    "layer_rename": {},          # {capa_origen: capa_nueva}
    "layer_exclude": [],         # capas que no se exportan
}

# parametros que afectan a la deteccion de hatches (clave de cache)
HATCH_KEYS = ("hatch_min_lines", "hatch_max_spacing_mm", "hatch_angle_tol", "hatch_spacing_tol",
              "hatch_gap_factor", "hatch_dashes", "hatch_isolated_only")

UNIT_DIV = {"mm": 1.0, "cm": 10.0, "m": 1000.0}


def model_factor(opts):
    """Unidades de dibujo por punto PDF."""
    if opts.get("scale_mode") == "factor" and opts.get("scale_factor"):
        return float(opts["scale_factor"])
    return PT_TO_MM * float(opts.get("scale_ratio") or 1.0) / UNIT_DIV.get(opts.get("units", "mm"), 1.0)


def sanitize_layer(name):
    name = re.sub(r'[<>/\\":;?*|=`,]', "_", name or "").strip()
    return name[:200] or "0"


def _hex(c):
    return "%02X%02X%02X" % tuple(c) if c else "000000"


class Converter:
    def __init__(self, pd, opts):
        self.pd = pd
        self.o = dict(DEFAULTS)
        self.o.update({k: v for k, v in (opts or {}).items() if v is not None or k == "scale_factor"})

    # ---------------- capas ----------------
    def layer_for(self, src_layer, color, width, kind):
        mode = self.o["layer_mode"]
        if kind == "text":
            base = "TEXTO" if mode != "single" else "PDF"
            if mode == "color":
                base = "TEXTO_" + _hex(color)
            return base
        if mode == "ocg":
            base = src_layer or ("C_" + _hex(color))
        elif mode == "color":
            base = "C_" + _hex(color)
        elif mode == "color_width":
            base = "C_%s_W%03d" % (_hex(color), int(round(width * PT_TO_MM * 100)))
        else:
            base = "PDF"
        if kind in ("hatch", "fill"):
            hl = self.o["hatch_layer"]
            if hl == "suffix":
                base = base + "_HATCH"
            elif hl == "single":
                base = "HATCH"
        return sanitize_layer(base)

    # ---------------- conversion ----------------
    def run(self, progress=None):
        """progress(fraccion 0..1, mensaje) opcional."""
        prog = progress or (lambda f, m="": None)
        pd, o = self.pd, self.o
        cache = getattr(pd, "cache", None)
        if cache is None:
            cache = pd.cache = {}
        res = {"hatches": [], "fills": [], "lines": [], "polys": [], "circles": [],
               "arcs": [], "splines": [], "texts": [], "stats": {}}

        # --- hatches de patron (la deteccion se cachea por parametros) ---
        all_hatches = []
        if o["detect_hatches"]:
            hkey = ("hatch",) + tuple(o[k] for k in HATCH_KEYS)
            if hkey not in cache:
                cache[hkey] = detect_hatches(
                    pd, o, progress=lambda f, m="": prog(0.02 + 0.53 * f, m))
            all_hatches = [dict(h) for h in cache[hkey]]
        prog(0.56, "Clasificando patrones")
        rejected = set(int(x) for x in (o.get("rejected_hatches") or []))
        consumed = set()
        for h in all_hatches:
            h["rejected"] = h["id"] in rejected
            layer, color, width = h["key"]
            h["layer"] = self.layer_for(layer, color, width, "hatch")
            h["color"] = color
            h["pat"] = classify_pattern(h, o["hatch_style"])
            h["pattern"], h["ptype"] = h["pat"]["name"], h["pat"]["ptype"]
            if not h["rejected"]:
                consumed.update(h["refs"])
        res["hatches"] = all_hatches
        if o["hatch_snap"] and all_hatches:
            skey = ("snap", hkey, frozenset(rejected))
            if skey not in cache:
                prog(0.58, "Ajustando contornos a muros")
                snap_hatch_boundaries(pd, all_hatches, consumed,
                                      progress=lambda f, m="": prog(0.58 + 0.14 * f, m))
                cache[skey] = {h["id"]: h["polygon"] for h in all_hatches if h.get("snapped")}
            for h in all_hatches:
                if h["id"] in cache[skey]:
                    h["polygon"] = cache[skey][h["id"]]
                    h["snapped"] = True
        n_hmerged = n_htrim = n_ftrim = 0
        if all_hatches and o["fix_overlaps"]:
            prog(0.72, "Limpiando contornos y solapes de hatches")
            all_hatches, n_hmerged, n_htrim = resolve_hatch_overlaps(all_hatches)
            res["hatches"] = all_hatches

        # --- rellenos solidos ---
        n_white = 0
        if o["fills"]:
            prog(0.73, "Fusionando rellenos solidos")
            fkey = ("fills", o["merge_fills"], o["skip_white_fills"])
            if fkey not in cache:
                cache[fkey] = build_fills(pd, o)
            fills, n_white = cache[fkey]
            fills = [dict(f) for f in fills]
            for f in fills:
                layer, color = f["key"]
                f["layer"] = self.layer_for(layer, color, 0, "fill")
                f["color"] = color
            if o["fix_overlaps"]:
                fills, n_ftrim = resolve_fill_overlaps(fills)
            res["fills"] = fills

        # --- trazos ---
        prog(0.80, "Convirtiendo lineas, arcos y polilineas")
        lines_by_key = defaultdict(list)
        n_src_segments = 0
        npaths = max(1, len(pd.paths))
        pstep = max(1, npaths // 20)
        for pi, path in enumerate(pd.paths):
            if pi % pstep == 0:
                prog(0.80 + 0.12 * pi / npaths, "Convirtiendo lineas %d / %d" % (pi, npaths))
            if path["kind"] == "fill":
                continue
            style = {
                "layer": self.layer_for(path["layer"], path["color"], path["width"], "line"),
                "color": path["color"],
                "width": path["width"],
                "dashes": path["dashes"] if o["linetypes"] else None,
            }
            for si, sp in enumerate(path["subpaths"]):
                segs = sp["segs"]
                n_src_segments += len(segs)
                runs, cur = [], []
                for ki, seg in enumerate(segs):
                    if (pi, si, ki) in consumed:
                        if cur:
                            runs.append(cur)
                        cur = []
                    else:
                        cur.append(seg)
                if cur:
                    runs.append(cur)
                closed = sp["closed"] and len(runs) == 1 and len(runs[0]) == len(segs)
                for run in runs:
                    self._emit_run(run, closed, style, res, lines_by_key)

        # --- lineas sueltas: fusion de colineales / duplicados ---
        prog(0.93, "Uniendo lineas colineales")
        for (lk, _), items in lines_by_key.items():
            style = items[0][1]
            if o["merge_collinear"]:
                for a, b in _merge_collinear([it[0] for it in items]):
                    res["lines"].append({"p1": a, "p2": b, **style})
            else:
                for (a, b), _ in items:
                    res["lines"].append({"p1": a, "p2": b, **style})

        # --- textos ---
        if o["texts"]:
            for t in pd.texts:
                t2 = dict(t)
                t2["layer"] = self.layer_for("", t["color"], 0, "text")
                res["texts"].append(t2)

        active = [h for h in all_hatches if not h["rejected"]]
        res["stats"] = {
            "paths_pdf": pd.n_raw_paths,
            "segmentos_pdf": n_src_segments,
            "hatches": len(active),
            "hatches_rechazados": len(all_hatches) - len(active),
            "lineas_hatch_absorbidas": len(consumed),
            "hatches_fusionados": n_hmerged,
            "solapes_corregidos": n_htrim + n_ftrim,
            "rellenos": len(res["fills"]),
            "rellenos_blancos_omitidos": n_white,
            "lineas": len(res["lines"]),
            "polilineas": len(res["polys"]),
            "circulos": len(res["circles"]),
            "arcos": len(res["arcs"]),
            "splines": len(res["splines"]),
            "textos": len(res["texts"]),
        }
        self._apply_layer_edits(res)
        prog(1.0, "Listo")
        res["k"] = model_factor(o)
        res["page"] = {"width": pd.width, "height": pd.height}
        res["opts"] = o
        return res

    def _apply_layer_edits(self, res):
        ren = {k: sanitize_layer(v) for k, v in (self.o.get("layer_rename") or {}).items() if v}
        excl = set(self.o.get("layer_exclude") or [])
        info = {}
        for kind in ("hatches", "fills", "lines", "polys", "circles", "arcs", "splines", "texts"):
            kept = []
            for e in res[kind]:
                src = e["layer"]
                li = info.setdefault(src, {"name": src, "count": 0, "color": e.get("color")})
                if not (kind == "hatches" and e.get("rejected")):
                    li["count"] += 1
                if src in excl:
                    continue
                e["src_layer"] = src
                e["layer"] = ren.get(src, src)
                kept.append(e)
            res[kind] = kept
        for name, li in info.items():
            li["excluded"] = name in excl
            li["rename"] = ren.get(name, "")
        res["layers"] = sorted(info.values(), key=lambda x: x["name"].lower())

    def _convert_curves(self, run):
        if not self.o["curves_to_arcs"]:
            return list(run)
        out = []
        for s in run:
            if s[0] == "C":
                if geom.is_straight_bezier(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], 0.05):
                    if geom.dist(s[1], s[4]) > 1e-6:
                        out.append(("L", s[1], s[4]))
                    continue
                arc = geom.bezier_to_arc(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4])
                if arc:
                    c, r, ccw = arc
                    out.append(("A", s[1], s[4], c, r, ccw))
                    continue
            out.append(s)
        return out

    def _emit_run(self, run, closed, style, res, lines_by_key):
        run = self._convert_curves(run)
        if not run:
            return
        # circulo completo
        if closed and all(s[0] == "A" for s in run):
            c0, r0 = run[0][3], run[0][4]
            if all(geom.dist(s[3], c0) < max(0.05, r0 * 0.01) and abs(s[4] - r0) < max(0.05, r0 * 0.01)
                   for s in run):
                total = sum(geom.arc_sweep(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[5]) for s in run)
                if abs(total - 2 * math.pi) < 0.05:
                    res["circles"].append({"c": c0, "r": r0, **style})
                    return
        if self.o["join_polylines"] and len(run) > 1:
            chunk = []
            for s in run:
                if s[0] == "C":
                    if chunk:
                        res["polys"].append({"segs": chunk, "closed": False, **style})
                        chunk = []
                    res["splines"].append({"ctrl": [s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4]], **style})
                else:
                    chunk.append(s)
            if chunk:
                is_closed = closed and len(chunk) == len(run)
                if len(chunk) == 1 and not is_closed:
                    self._emit_single(chunk[0], style, res, lines_by_key)
                else:
                    res["polys"].append({"segs": chunk, "closed": is_closed, **style})
            return
        for s in run:
            self._emit_single(s, style, res, lines_by_key)

    def _emit_single(self, s, style, res, lines_by_key):
        if s[0] == "L":
            key = (style["layer"], style["color"], round(style["width"], 3), str(style["dashes"]))
            lines_by_key[(key, 0)].append(((s[1], s[2]), style))
        elif s[0] == "A":
            res["arcs"].append({"p1": s[1], "p2": s[2], "c": s[3], "r": s[4], "ccw": s[5], **style})
        elif s[0] == "C":
            res["splines"].append({"ctrl": [s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4]], **style})


def snap_hatch_boundaries(pd, hatches, consumed, progress=None):
    """El contorno deducido de las lineas queda hasta un espaciado por dentro del
    contorno real. Si las lineas existentes (muros, contornos) cierran una region
    que contiene al hatch y es solo un poco mayor, se usa esa region.

    Rendimiento: todas las regiones cerradas del plano se calculan UNA vez
    (nodado + polygonize global) y luego se cruzan con los hatches en bloque."""
    import numpy as np
    import shapely

    prog = progress or (lambda f, m=None: None)
    act = [h for h in hatches if not h.get("rejected")]
    if not act:
        return
    prog(0.0, "Buscando recintos cerrados")
    straight, curved = [], []
    for pi, path in enumerate(pd.paths):
        if path["kind"] == "fill":
            continue
        for si, sp in enumerate(path["subpaths"]):
            for ki, seg in enumerate(sp["segs"]):
                if (pi, si, ki) in consumed:
                    continue
                if seg[0] == "L":
                    straight.append((seg[1], seg[2]))
                else:
                    curved.append(geom.flatten_segment(seg))
    parts = []
    if straight:
        arr = np.array(straight, dtype=float)
        keep = np.hypot(arr[:, 1, 0] - arr[:, 0, 0], arr[:, 1, 1] - arr[:, 0, 1]) > 1e-3
        parts.append(shapely.linestrings(arr[keep]))
    if curved:
        parts.append(np.array([shapely.LineString(c) for c in curved if len(c) > 1], dtype=object))
    if not parts:
        return
    lines = np.concatenate(parts)
    if len(lines) == 0:
        return
    try:
        noded = shapely.union_all(lines)
        prog(0.35, "Calculando recintos")
        faces = shapely.get_parts(shapely.polygonize(shapely.get_parts(noded)))
    except Exception:
        return
    if len(faces) == 0:
        return
    faces = np.asarray(faces, dtype=object)
    fa = shapely.area(faces)
    prog(0.6, "Cruzando %d hatches con %d recintos" % (len(act), len(faces)))

    polys = np.array([h["polygon"] for h in act], dtype=object)
    pa = shapely.area(polys)
    sp_ = np.array([max(f["spacing"] for f in h["families"]) for h in act])
    max_area = pa + shapely.length(polys) * sp_ * 0.75

    tree = shapely.STRtree(faces)
    hi, fi = tree.query(polys)  # solape de cajas
    # una cara solo sirve si es candidata (<= max_area) o si puede quedar cubierta
    # al 60% por el hatch (area <= area_hatch / 0.6): se descartan antes de intersecar
    lim = np.maximum(max_area, pa / 0.6)
    m = fa[fi] <= lim[hi]
    hi, fi = hi[m], fi[m]
    # 1) contencion (geometria preparada, barata): si el recinto contiene al hatch,
    #    la interseccion es el propio hatch y no hace falta calcularla
    shapely.prepare(faces)
    # (se encoge un poco: el contorno deducido lleva un margen de ~2% del espaciado)
    shrunk = shapely.buffer(polys, -0.05 * sp_, join_style="mitre")
    shrunk = np.where(shapely.is_empty(shrunk), polys, shrunk)
    cont = shapely.contains(faces[fi], shrunk[hi])
    inter = np.where(cont, pa[hi], 0.0)
    ok_c = cont & (fa[fi] >= pa[hi] * 0.98) & (fa[fi] <= max_area[hi])
    resolved = np.zeros(len(act), dtype=bool)
    resolved[hi[ok_c]] = True
    # 2) interseccion exacta solo para hatches sin recinto contenedor valido
    need = ~cont & ~resolved[hi]
    if need.any():
        inter[need] = shapely.area(shapely.intersection(faces[fi[need]], polys[hi[need]]))
    m = inter > 0
    hi, fi, inter = hi[m], fi[m], inter[m]

    order = np.argsort(hi, kind="stable")
    hi, fi, inter = hi[order], fi[order], inter[order]
    starts = np.searchsorted(hi, np.arange(len(act)))
    ends = np.searchsorted(hi, np.arange(len(act)), side="right")
    n = len(act)
    for k in range(n):
        if k % 50 == 0:
            prog(0.6 + 0.4 * k / n, "Ajustando contornos %d / %d" % (k, n))
        a0, a1 = starts[k], ends[k]
        if a0 == a1:
            continue
        f_k, i_k = fi[a0:a1], inter[a0:a1]
        fa_k = fa[f_k]
        ok = (fa_k >= pa[k] * 0.98) & (fa_k <= max_area[k]) & (i_k >= 0.97 * pa[k])
        best = None
        if ok.any():
            c = np.flatnonzero(ok)
            best = faces[f_k[c[np.argmin(fa_k[c])]]]
        else:
            # hatch que ocupa varias caras (p.ej. con islas): union de caras cubiertas
            cov = i_k >= 0.6 * fa_k
            if cov.any():
                u = shapely.union_all(faces[f_k[cov]])
                if (u.area >= pa[k] * 0.98 and u.area <= max_area[k]
                        and u.intersection(polys[k]).area >= 0.97 * pa[k]):
                    best = u
        if best is not None:
            act[k]["polygon"] = best
            act[k]["snapped"] = True


def _merge_collinear(segs, ang_q=0.05, off_q=0.02):
    """Fusiona segmentos colineales que se tocan o solapan (y elimina duplicados)."""
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for a, b in segs:
        dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
        L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if L < 1e-6:
            continue
        ang = math.atan2(dy, dx) % math.pi
        if ang > math.pi - 1e-4:
            ang = 0.0
        ux, uy = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        off = -a[0] * uy + a[1] * ux
        t1, t2 = a[0] * ux + a[1] * uy, b[0] * ux + b[1] * uy
        kq = (round(math.degrees(ang) / ang_q), round(off / off_q))
        groups[kq].append((min(t1, t2), max(t1, t2), ang, off, a, b))
    out = []
    for items in groups.values():
        if len(items) == 1:
            it = items[0]
            out.append((it[4], it[5]))
            continue
        items.sort()
        ang, off = items[0][2], items[0][3]
        ux, uy = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        cur0, cur1 = items[0][0], items[0][1]
        spans = []
        for t0, t1, *_ in items[1:]:
            if t0 <= cur1 + 1e-3:
                cur1 = max(cur1, t1)
            else:
                spans.append((cur0, cur1))
                cur0, cur1 = t0, t1
        spans.append((cur0, cur1))
        for t0, t1 in spans:
            p = (t0 * ux - off * uy, t0 * uy + off * ux)
            q = (t1 * ux - off * uy, t1 * uy + off * ux)
            out.append((p, q))
    return out


def convert(pd, opts, progress=None):
    return Converter(pd, opts).run(progress)
